blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents increasingly act over streaming omni-modal observations spanning screenshots, audio, video, interaction history, and device states. However, exposing this complete context uniformly at every step ignores that relevance is transient and sparse: the signal determining one action can become clutter at the next. Because executed actions feed back into the context, these errors compound into Sequential Distraction, driving the agent into irreversible trajectory drift. We formulate the underlying requirement as Focused Perception: a representation that is step-adaptive, action-sufficient, and non-intrusive. We realize this in FocusGUI, a lightweight adapter that dynamically prioritizes multimodal channels against a step-specific decision reference. Instead of uniformly processing all inputs, it compresses the most relevant evidence into a compact latent and subtly injects it into the frozen decoder's embeddings, guiding the model's attention without altering its native parameter space. FocusGUI trains from action supervision alone, requiring neither modality-relevance labels nor backbone fine-tuning. Across four omni-modal backbones, it raises overall Type Match by +33.2 and Exact Match by 3.0 times over the frozen backbone on average, and Type Match by +30.1 over the strongest existing enhancement method.
blocks.zh: 图形用户界面(GUI)代理越来越多地在横跨截图、音频、视频、互动历史以及设备状态的流出全方位模式观测中发挥作用。 然而,在每一个步骤上统一揭露这一完整的背景都忽略了相关性是短暂和稀少的:决定一个行动的信号在下一个步骤上会变得模糊不清. 由于执行的行动反馈到上下文中,这些错误会复合到序列分解,使剂进入不可逆转的轨道漂移. 我们提出基本要求,即 " 有重点的观念 " :一种能够逐步适应、行动充足和无侵犯性的代表性。 我们在FocusGUI中认识到这一点,FocusGUI是一个轻量级的适配器,它根据具体步骤的决定参考,动态地优先考虑多式渠道。 它不统一处理所有输入,而是将最相关的证据压缩成紧凑的潜伏并潜入被冻结的解码器的嵌入,引导模型的注意力,而不会改变其原生参数空间. blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents are shifting from parsing static screenshots to acting on dynamic, streaming observations across multiple modalities ( Henry et al., 2026 ; Jang et al., 2025 ; Yao et al., 2026 ) . In realistic computing environments, the evidence needed for the next action need not be confined to the current visual frame. An unexpected notification chime might demand an immediate context switch, a specific transition in a live video can dictate when to click, and spoken instructions must be continuously mapped to visual changes on the screen ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . Contemporary omni-modal models can ingest screenshots, video streams, audio, interaction history, and device states within a single network ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Cui et al., 2026 ) . This has naturally led to a default paradigm: exposing the complete multimodal observation to the model at every interaction step and leaving it to implicitly determine what matters while generating the action.
blocks.zh: 图形用户界面(GUI)的代理正在从剖析静态截图转向跨多模式的动态相流观测(Henry等,2026;Jang等,2025;姚等,2026). 在现实的计算环境中,下一步行动所需的证据不必局限于目前的视觉框架. 一个出乎意料的通知小调可能要求立即上下文切换,现场视频中的具体过渡可以决定何时点击,而口语指令必须被连续地映射到屏幕上的视觉变化(ByteDance Seed,2026;Li等,2026;Yuan等,2026;Chen等,2025). 当代全能模式模式可以在单一网络内摄取截图,视频流,音频,交互历史,设备状态(徐等,2025;傅等,2025;邱等,2026.). 这自然导致了一种默认的范式:在每一个互动步骤上将完整的多式联运观察暴露在模型上,让它在产生行动的同时隐含地决定什么才是重要的.

blocks.en: Leaving this selection entirely to the decoder assumes that it can reliably rediscover what matters from the complete observation at every interaction step. Our analysis reveals why this is difficult (Fig. 1 ). When individual modalities are removed during multi-step interaction, the dominant modality switches across nearly half of adjacent steps; even within a single step, only a small fraction of the observation may support the decision, while the rest can become distracting. Relevance is therefore fundamentally a property of the step , not a static property of the observation. Yet the decoder is forced to rediscover this relevance at every step, without any explicit signal of what has changed. In a closed-loop agent, such misreads do not end with the current prediction: the executed action changes the environment and feeds back into the observation and history of the next step, allowing errors to compound over time. We refer to this compounding failure as Sequential Distraction .
blocks.zh: 将这个选择完全留给解码器,假设它能够可靠地从每个互动步骤的完整观察中重新发现重要的事物. 我们的分析揭示了为什么这样做很困难(图1)。 当单个模式在多步骤互动中被去除时,主导模式会跨越相邻步骤的近一半;即使在一个步骤中,也只有一小部分观察可以支持决定,而其余的则会变得分心. 因此,相关性基本上是步骤的财产,而不是观察的静态财产。 然而,解码器被迫在每一个步骤上重新发现这种相关性,而没有任何关于变化的明确信号。 在闭路代理中,这种错误读取不会以当前预测而结束:被执行的动作会改变环境并反馈到下一步的观察和历史中,允许错误随时间而复合. 我们把这种复杂的失败称为分心。

blocks.en: The most intuitive remedy is to perform subtraction on the inputs. This is exactly what existing methods attempt: cropping parts of the current screen to retain only candidate regions of interest ( Lu et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026b ; Cheng et al., 2024 ) . However, this strategy of giving less fundamentally misaligns with the nature of streaming interaction in two ways. First, the decisive signal could emerge from audio, video, or device status at any moment, channels entirely outside the scope of spatial cropping. Second, even when the signal resides on the screen, the crudely cropped background often contains the essential contextual evidence needed to ground accurate coordinates and text parameters. The problem is not that the decoder is given too much, but that it lacks guidance on how to prioritize it. A proper focus mechanism should change how the decoder reads the observation, rather than altering what it is given .
blocks.zh: 最直观的补救措施是对投入进行减法. 这正是现有方法所尝试的:在目前的屏幕上裁剪部分,只保留候选利益区(Lu等,2024;Luo等,2025;Liu等,2026b;Cheng等,2024)。 然而,这种在两个方面给予与流互动性质较少根本性错配的策略. 首先,决定性的信号可能从音频、视频或设备状态随时出现,这些渠道完全超出空间裁剪的范围。 其次,即使信号停留在屏幕上,粗糙的裁剪背景也往往包含为绘制准确坐标和文字参数而需要的基本背景证据. 问题不在于解码器被给予过多,而在于它缺乏关于如何优先排序的指导. 适当的焦点机制应该改变解码器如何读取观察,而不是改变它给出的内容。

blocks.en: We realize this principle in FocusGUI (Fig. 2 ). Since the decoder can already read the full observation and what it lacks is a signal of what matters at the current step, FocusGUI leaves both the backbone and its input untouched and supplies that signal alongside them. At every step, it exposes the observation as separable perceptual channels, scores each against a reference derived from the current observation as a whole, and compresses the prioritized channels into a compact focus latent. The latent enters as a zero-initialized residual at the boundary where the decoder begins to generate the action. This residual reallocates attention over the entire observation without altering it, guiding both the choice of action and the grounding of its arguments. Training uses next-action supervision alone, with no labels indicating which modality matters.
blocks.zh: 我们在FocusGUI(图2)中实现了这一原则。 由于解码器已经能够读取完整的观测结果,而它所缺乏的则是当前步骤中重要内容的信号,FocusGUI使主干及其输入都未受影响,并附带信号的供给. 在每一个步骤上,它都会将观察暴露为可分辨的知觉通道,根据从当前观察整体中得出的参考结果对每个通道进行分分,并将优先渠道压缩为紧凑的焦点潜伏. 潜入者在解码器开始产生作用的边界上作为零初始残留进入. 这一剩余部分将注意力重新分配给整个观察,而不改变它,指导行动的选择及其论点的依据。 培训仅使用下一步行动监督,没有标签说明哪种方式很重要。

The gains grow with interaction depth, as Sequential Distraction predicts: from the first step to the fourth, the frozen Qwen2.5-Omni loses half of its Type Match while FocusGUI retains 86.8%. Gradients propagate through the frozen decoder to ϕ \phi , while the omni-modal backbone, decoder, and language-model head receive no parameter updates.

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate on OmniGUI ( Henry et al., 2026 ) , a benchmark of omni-modal smartphone GUI interactions across 29 applications; we use 708 episodes with 2,572 action steps. Each step pairs a screenshot with synchronous audio, video, and action history, so the decisive signal can come from any of the four streams. We report Type Match (TM), Exact Match (EM), and Goal Progress (GP). TM checks whether the predicted action primitive matches the ground truth; EM further requires predicted coordinates to fall within the target element’s bounding box and generated text to match the reference. GP is the fraction of correctly executed steps per episode, averaged across episodes.

blocks.en: We evaluate four representative open-source omni-modal backbones: Qwen2.5-Omni ( Xu et al., 2025 ) , VITA-1.5 ( Fu et al., 2025 ) , MiniCPM-o 4.5 ( Cui et al., 2026 ) , and Baichuan-Omni-1.5 ( Li et al., 2025b ) . The four backbones support textual, visual, auditory, and temporal inputs but differ in architecture and multimodal representation, which lets the comparison probe the generality of FocusGUI across backbone families. For each backbone, the base model stays frozen, and training updates only the lightweight FocusGUI head and action predictors, using the same episode-disjoint split across all four models.

blocks.en: Consistent gains across backbones. Table 1 evaluates four omni-modal backbones under identical frozen weights. Averaged across them, FocusGUI adds 33.2 TM, 22.3 EM, and 6.6 GP points over direct inference and 30.1, 23.6, and 8.0 points over the strongest baseline at each backbone. Why screen refinement backfires. The baselines fail in a way that is diagnostic rather than incidental.
DRS-GUI, OmniParser, and RegionFocus are near-neutral on TM ( + 0.9 +0.9 points on
average) yet lower EM by 28% and GP by 35% in relative terms, in 12 of 12
cases for each metric. Narrowing a screenshot makes the action primitive more
salient, which is what TM rewards, while discarding the surrounding context
that fixes coordinates and text, which is what EM requires. None of the three
reaches audio, video, or device state, so a decision resting on those channels
stays unrecoverable however the screen is processed. This is what our framing
predicts: once relevance is a property of a step rather than of a region,
refining the region cannot restore it and may cost more than it returns.

blocks.en: Where the gains come from. The structure of the gains indicates what the representation supplies. Per-category TM gains run from 37.3 points on Temporal, where the decisive signal persists across frames and a single screenshot serves worst, to 27.8 on Instant, where the decision is reactive and largely present on the current screen; EM follows the same order. Across backbones, the overall TM spread narrows from 35.6 points to 13.0, indicating that choosing the correct primitive becomes substantially less backbone-dependent under a better-organized observation. EM variation instead reflects backbone-specific argument-generation capacity. At episode level, improvements in per-step prediction translate into Goal Progress when they are sustained across the trajectory. Episode progress is gated by the weakest step in a trajectory.

blocks.en: 4.1 GUI Agents in Omni-Modal Environments
blocks.zh: 4.1 Omni- Modal 环境中的图形用户界面代理

blocks.en:
GUI agents interact with digital environments by repeatedly translating user
intentions and interface observations into executable actions. Research across
mobile, web, and desktop platforms has established this perception–action
loop and progressively extended it from isolated grounding decisions to
long-horizon interaction ( Rawles et al., 2023 ; Deng et al., 2023 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) . Most
agents nevertheless organize their observation around the current screenshot,
with previous actions or screens retained as auxiliary context. Temporal GUI
benchmarks broaden this view by requiring agents to understand dynamic visual
content ( Jang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , while OmniGUI further
places each action within an interleaved observation of screen, video, audio,
and interaction history ( Henry et al., 2026 ) . These
developments shift GUI interaction from processing a sequence of interfaces to
acting over an evolving omni-modal state.

In parallel, omni-modal foundation models increasingly support unified or
streaming perception of text, vision, and audio ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Cui et al., 2026 ) . Broader evaluations of real-time

complementary problem inside an omni-modal agent: given the complete
observation, it learns which evidence should shape the current action and how

blocks.en: 4.2 Perception and Grounding for GUI Agents
blocks.zh: 4.2 图形用户界面代理的概念和基础

blocks.en:
Perception is central to GUI agents because an instruction must ultimately be
connected to an actionable interface element. One line of work strengthens
this connection through GUI-specific representation learning and large-scale
grounding data ( Cheng et al., 2024 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Gou et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025b ) ; another exposes explicit interface
structure to general-purpose models through screen parsing ( Lu et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Fu et al., 2026 ) . Recent visual agents also reduce redundant
screen tokens while jointly learning grounding and action generation ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026c ) . Together, these methods improve how an agent understands the
current interface and determines where an action should be executed.

A complementary direction makes perception selective. Rather than processing

Omni-modal interaction introduces an additional axis, since relevance also
changes across information sources and action steps. FocusGUI extends focused perception from spatial localization to step-dependent representation construction over the complete observation, complementing existing GUI grounding mechanisms.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We identify Sequential Distraction as a primary challenge in multi-step omni-modal GUI interaction, where unfiltered observations can lead to compounding errors due to transient and sparse relevance. To address this, we formulate the concept of Focused Perception and implement it through FocusGUI, a lightweight adapter that dynamically prioritizes perceptual channels, compresses them into an action-sufficient latent, and delivers the result via a zero-initialized residual at the action boundary. This method relies solely on action annotations and leaves the underlying backbone completely frozen. Evaluations across four backbones demonstrate that FocusGUI substantially improves Type Match over existing enhancement methods and maintains high accuracy at deeper interaction steps where historical context typically degrades. While our current prioritization depends on the present observation, future work could extend this mechanism to anticipate channel relevance, which may help mitigate trajectory drift earlier in the interaction sequence.
blocks.zh: 我们确定,分级分流是多步骤全方位模式GUI互动中的一项主要挑战,其中未过滤的观测可导致因瞬间和无关性而导致复杂的错误。 为了解决这一问题,我们制定了聚焦感知概念,并通过FocusGUI加以实施,FocusGUI是一个轻量级的适配器,它能动态地确定知觉通道的优先次序,将其压缩成一个能满足行动的潜在,并通过在行动边界上零初始化的残留来交付结果. 这种方法完全依靠动作说明,使基础骨干被完全冻结. 跨越四个主干线的评价表明,FocusGUI比起现有的增强方法,大大改进了类型匹配,并在历史背景通常会退化的更深层次互动步骤上保持了高精度. 虽然我们目前的优先次序取决于目前的意见,但今后的工作可以扩大这一机制,以预测渠道的相关性,这可能有助于减缓在互动序列中较早时的轨迹漂移。

blocks.en: FocusGUI is designed as a lightweight mechanism for improving how frozen omni-modal GUI agents organize step-dependent evidence, and it is complementary to advances in perception, grounding, and planning. Our current formulation computes channel priorities from the observation available at each interaction step, which keeps the method simple and model-agnostic; extending this mechanism to incorporate anticipatory signals about which evidence may become important in subsequent steps is a natural direction for future work. Our experiments span four omni-modal backbones and five interaction categories; extending focused perception to broader computer-use settings is a natural next step.

blocks.en:
FocusGUI adds trainable parameters to a
frozen backbone, so part of its gain could in principle come from that budget
alone. Table 5 holds the budget fixed to within 79
parameters and replaces the decision reference with a fixed concatenation layout,
leaving the channels available but no longer scored per step. This control
differs from the uniform-priority variant in Table 2 :
uniform priorities average the channel embeddings with equal weights, so channel
identity is lost in the pooled representation, whereas concatenation keeps each
channel in its own slot and lets the downstream projection learn a fixed,
step-independent weighting. It is therefore the stronger static baseline, and
isolates per-step scoring as the only difference. Dynamic
prioritization improves all three metrics, with the largest gains on Exact

(+0.98). The gain therefore appears where the mechanism is meant to act, on
executable grounding rather than on primitive selection, and it is not
explained by latent capacity.

blocks.en:
We construct episode-disjoint training, validation, and test sets containing
1,807, 257, and 508 interaction steps from 495, 71, and 142 trajectories,
respectively. All feature transformations and normalization statistics are
fitted using the training split only. Validation data are used exclusively
for checkpoint selection, and the test split is evaluated once after model
selection. At inference time, the original LM head generates one structured
action using greedy decoding with beam size one. Raw backbones and their FocusGUI variants use identical observations, prompts, action histories, action spaces, and decoding configurations. On Qwen2.5-Omni, FocusGUI contains 1.445M trainable parameters compared with 8.932B frozen Thinker parameters, corresponding to only 0.0162 % 0.0162\% trainable parameters. We train a separate FocusGUI adapter for each of the four backbones, with no adapter parameters shared across backbone families. Across the evaluated backbones, the adapter size ranges from 1.15M to 1.45M parameters. All experiments are conducted using two NVIDIA
L20 GPUs.

blocks.en: Appendix F Case Study
blocks.zh: 附录F 案例研究

blocks.en: To demonstrate the comprehensiveness and robustness of FocusGUI across diverse interaction paradigms, we present two distinct case studies encompassing both cross-modal temporal reasoning and multi-step semantic localization. Real-world GUI operation requires agents to seamlessly transition between different cognitive modes: some tasks demand patient monitoring of streaming sensory inputs (e.g., waiting for an auditory cue), while others require precise, sequential spatial navigation through dense interfaces.
blocks.zh: 为了表明FocusGUI在不同互动范式中的全面性和稳健性,我们提出了两个不同的案例研究,既包括跨模式时间推理,也包括多步骤语义本地化。 现实世界的GUI操作需要代理在不同的认知模式之间无缝地过渡:有些任务需要病人对流传的感官输入进行监控(例如等待听觉提示),而另一些任务则需要通过密集的界面进行精确,相继的空间导航.

blocks.en: The following examples illustrate how FocusGUI successfully navigates these contrasting extremes by dynamically prioritizing relevant perceptual channels. Figure 11 highlights a scenario where the decisive signal is entirely auditory and temporal, requiring the agent to ignore static visual saliency until a specific semantic condition is met. Conversely, Figure 12 showcases a highly spatial and semantic task, where the agent must execute a precise sequence of UI interactions (opening filters, selecting specific nested options) based on a composite text instruction. Together, these cases confirm that FocusGUI’s step-adaptive prioritization effectively generalizes across fundamentally different types of GUI challenges, preventing Sequential Distraction in both streaming and structurally complex environments.
blocks.zh: 以下例子说明FocusGUI如何通过动态地确定相关认知渠道的优先次序,成功导航这些相形见绌的极端. 图11突出了决定性信号完全为听觉和时间性的情景,要求代理人在满足特定语义条件之前忽略静态视觉特征. 相反地,图12展现出一个高度空间和语义化的任务,即代理人必须执行一个基于复合文本指令的精确的UI相互作用序列(打开过滤器,选择特定的嵌入选项). 这些案例共同证实,FocusGUI的逐步调整优先有效概括了基本不同类型的GUI挑战,防止了串流和结构复杂环境中的分流。

blocks.en: Figure 11: Case study on cross-modal temporal reasoning. The agent is instructed to pause a video based on specific auditory cues ("past/history/childhood"). The visual interface remains largely static, forcing the model to rely on streaming audio comprehension over multiple steps. FocusGUI successfully avoids premature visual actions, dynamically shifting priority to the audio channel and executing the spatial action (tapping pause) precisely when the semantic condition is met.
blocks.zh: 图11:跨模式时间推理案例研究。 特务被指示根据特定听觉提示("过去/历史/孩子")暂停视频. 视觉界面基本保持静态,迫使模型依赖流传的音频理解来完成多步. FocusGUI成功地避免了不成熟的视觉动作,动态地将优先级转移到了音频通道上,并且恰好在语义条件得到满足时执行空间动作(tapping stop).

blocks.en: Figure 12: Case study on multi-step semantic planning and spatial localization. The agent executes a complex sequence of interface interactions based on a detailed text instruction. It successfully navigates through dynamic UI changes—locating a small filter icon, understanding the popup menu, and sequentially selecting "Like count", "Liked", and "This Week". This demonstrates FocusGUI’s capacity for precise spatial grounding and robust state tracking in visually dense environments.
blocks.zh: 图12:多步骤语义规划和空间定位案例研究. 代理根据详细的文本指令执行复杂的界面交互序列. 它通过动态的 UI 变化成功地导航—— 分配一个小的过滤图标, 理解弹出菜单, 并按顺序选择“ 喜欢数 ” 、 “ 喜欢数 ” 和 “ 本周 ” 。 这表明FocusGUI有能力在视觉密集环境中精确地进行空间定位和稳健状态跟踪。
